headline: BULLISH
headline_tag: Uptrend intact, but the long-term trend backdrop is still weak

action.title: SCALE UP acquisition budget
action.detail: This suggests a measured step up in acquisition and campaign budgets rather than an all-in push. Recent price action is constructive and market mood is upbeat, so spending on active-trader channels is likely to be better received right now. Confidence is medium because the longer-term trend has not turned up yet and macro conditions (10-year yield 5.24%, VIX 16) are mixed, so it is sensible to release budget in stages and review if conditions change. This is a budget-posture guide, not trading advice.

reasons: Price sits 17% above its 200-day average (Mayer 1.17) and up 39% over 90 days.
Sentiment is the strongest input: Fear & Greed 73, funding mildly positive (z +0.71).
The 200-day average itself is still falling (-5% over 90 days).
Price remains 33% below its all-time high; 10-year yield at 5.24% is a headwind.
watch: The main tension is short-term strength against a weak long-term base: price and 90-day momentum are up, but the 200-day average is still sloping down, breadth is under half (47%) and sentiment is running ahead of trend at 73 on Fear & Greed. ETF flows are roughly flat today (-$12.9M, cumulative +$57.6B) and public companies hold about 1.28M BTC, so structural demand is not obviously accelerating. The read would firm up if the 200-day average stops falling and breadth improves; it would weaken if price slips back toward that average while sentiment cools. All figures are trailing, not a forecast.
